text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The central committee of the Party for Democratic Prosperity (ethnic Albanian) on Saturday decided to remain in government. At the same time the party will continue negotiations with coalition partner the Social Democratic Alliance of Macedonia (SDAM) about legalisation of the Tetovo university, Albanian presence in administration and introduction of Albanian as a second language, paper comments.

- The Social Democratic Alliance of Macedonia (SDAM) central committee at its session on Sunday concluded the party results at November local elections were satisfactory. "We are ready for dialogue with our partners in the government on all open issues in order to build a platform for joint action," SDAM president and Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski said.

- Jankulovski family from Bitola decided to reveal a family secret guarded for 150 years. They claim to own a picture by famous Italian artist Leonardo da Vinci painted in 1502. Custodians from the Prado and Louvre museums are interested in the painting whose value is estimated at over one million German marks.
